testEffect: Replacing the controlled explicit timestamp with an uncontrolled real-time call (`Date.now() + 10_000`) would allow large offsets to mask timeout regressions.
productionEffect: Corrupting `isSessionExpired`'s threshold (multiplying `timeoutMs` by 10) is expected to fail this test as written; substituting the uncontrolled real-time variant described above against that same corrupted function would let it keep passing, showing the controlled clock is what actually catches the regression.
